lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct vertical lines are visible; spacing is narrower in the anterior section and becomes progressively wider toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 4th and 6th lines (counting from anterior) are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso; the 8th line is a short segment near the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 3 distinct high-contrast white spots is located on the upper lateral aspect of the posterior hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally, creating a short geometric segment parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate spiral trajectory, extending posterodorsally from the skull before curving inward toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory tips represent approximately 15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white facial spots on the cheek/mandible area; high-contrast tan/orange 'socks' on distal limbs; elongated dark hair fringe along the ventral midline.
